meta.source_detail: Generated locally to the real Ingolstadt/VGI schemas. Figures are illustrative and must not be read as official statistics.

glossary.avg_daily_traffic_citywide: Mean vehicles counted per day across all loop detectors.
glossary.forecast_mae: Mean absolute error of the demand model, averaged over 4 rolling-origin CV folds (± is the spread across folds). Lower is better.
glossary.forecast_r2: Share of hourly variance explained by the model (0-1), mean across folds.
glossary.baseline_mae: Seasonal-naive baseline: predict the same hour one week earlier.
glossary.calendar_only_mae: A model using only calendar and weather features - the honest benchmark to beat.
glossary.lift_over_calendar_pct: How much the full model improves on the calendar-only model.
glossary.avg_peak_headway_min: Mean minutes between consecutive departures during 07:00-09:00 and 16:00-18:00.
glossary.n_underserved_stops: Stops in the bottom quintile of weekday departures.
glossary.n_charging_points: Individual charging connectors (a station may have several).
glossary.dq_rows_checked: Rows validated by the data-quality gate before any analysis ran.

summary.method: heuristic gap score (normalised demand minus normalised supply)
caveats: gap_score is ordinal, not a physical unit
grid capacity, land availability and cost are not modelled
OSM/demo charging inventory may be incomplete
